item.title: Promote a Design from Staging to Production
item.description: A pipeline is only as trustworthy as its boundaries. In this tutorial you build two stages of one in a single organization: a staging workspace and a production workspace, each with its own team and its own environment. You put a design in staging, promote it to production, deploy it to the production environment from Kanvas, and read the production workspace’s activity log to confirm every change and who made it.
